theme: Light mode primary (to reflect clean, professional software workspace) with high contrast. Use white and light grays for surfaces, black for typography.

typography.instructions: Import Outfit and Manrope via Google Fonts. Use Outfit for headings and primary metrics. Use Manrope for data tables, form inputs, and body text.

rules: NEVER use random colors. Stick strictly to this official BMW palette.
NO Material Design default shadows or colors.
BMW Blue (#0066B1) is the main action color for primary CTAs.
BMW M colors (Light Blue, Dark Blue, Red) ONLY for accents, active navigation states, KPI indicators, or tags.
Backgrounds should be pristine White or Light Gray.

mobile.navigation: Fixed bottom bar `fixed bottom-0 w-full` with 4 main items (Inicio, Stock, Plano, Entregas). Use glassmorphism: `bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#F5F6F8] pb-safe`. NEVER fully transparent.
mobile.sidebar: Hidden by default, accessible via a menu/hamburger button in the top header for secondary modules (Mobiliario, Estadísticas, Configuración).

desktop.navigation: Fixed left sidebar (`w-64` or `w-72`), `bg-[#F5F6F8]` or White with a subtle right border `border-r border-gray-200`. Ample workspace margin on the right.
desktop.workspace: Max-width containers or fluid full-width depending on module, using generous padding like `p-8` or `p-12`.

layouts.grid_system: Bento-inspired grid for Dashboard KPIs (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6`), using clean, well-spaced cards.

login_screen.layout: Split screen on desktop, stacked on mobile.
login_screen.visuals: Left side (or top on mobile): Premium BMW showroom image. Right side: Clean, minimalist login form.

app_shell.instructions: Implement responsive shell bridging mobile-first bottom nav and desktop side nav. Content area must scroll independently of nav bars.

dashboard_kpis.style: Cards with soft shadows (`shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]`, hover: `shadow-md`), `rounded-xl`, `bg-white`, `border border-[#F5F6F8]`.
dashboard_kpis.content: Total vehicles, by status, by location. Use BMW M-colors for micro-indicators (e.g., Red for 'Delivery Pending', Light Blue for 'In Showroom').

stock_module.list_view: Clean data table or list cards. High contrast text. Use small pill badges for Status.
stock_module.filters: Top bar or sliding panel for filters (Model, Status, Location) and search.
stock_module.vehicle_form: Grid layout forms using Shadcn inputs. Fields: Marca, Modelo, Motor, Categoría, Color, Código color BMW, VIN, VIN corto, Matrícula, Ubicación, Estado, Cliente, Teléfono, Observaciones.

visual_enhancers.border_radius: Rounded but structured. Prefer `rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl` for large cards, `rounded-lg` for inputs/buttons.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only on fixed navs/headers: `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border-b border-gray-100`. NEVER 100% transparent.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid `#F5F6F8` or `#E5E7EB` to delineate areas cleanly.

rules: Fluid, smooth animations inspired by automotive interfaces. No jarring or overly bouncy effects.

icons_and_media.icon_style: Thin or Light weight to match the premium iDrive aesthetic.

image_urls.description: White BMW car parked indoors in a sleek dark environment. Perfect for the login screen background.
Red leather BMW interior. Great for generic headers or placeholder visual content.
Blue BMW M series. Good for vehicle placeholders in the stock module.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure black/dark gray text passes WCAG AA on white/light gray.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: CRITICAL: All interactive elements, inputs, and KPI cards MUST have `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='kpi-total-stock'`).
accessibility_and_testing.focus: Focus states must use BMW Blue outline: `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0066B1] focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-1`.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this JSON carefully before building any component. Your target is .js/.jsx files.
Initialize Tailwind config with the exact color hex codes provided under 'colors'.
Set up layout shell first: A responsive component that renders a bottom bar on mobile and a side nav on desktop.
Use Shadcn UI for forms, tables, and dropdowns, but OVERRIDE their default styles (colors, border-radius) to match this premium BMW aesthetic.
For the vehicle form, construct a grid layout for the numerous required fields.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Remember: The design must feel like BMW iDrive—clean, spacious, legible, premium. Avoid clutter.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not center everything. Left-align text for readability.
DO NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Use 2-3x more spacing than default. `p-8` is a good baseline for containers.
Never use AI emoji characters for icons.
Ensure glassmorphism is legible (no pure transparent backgrounds over content).
